description: Runs of the compiled Job Search graph that fail partway and are resumed from their checkpoint, as a restarted worker would. `fault` says what goes wrong: the action executor raising `failures` times before it succeeds (`executor`), or the same inbound message delivered `times` times (`redelivery`). `recoverable` is whether a correct system finishes the work by resuming alone, with no manual repair; `max_resumes` is how many resumes it gets. `expected` is the end state, and every case must leave no side effect duplicated. Synthetic.
